filter_note.note: Sunday Week 4 results night, stamped Week 5 vibe week (Sun 10/4 start). Injury/status: Lamar ankle exit (Huntley), Barkley hamstring, Chase concussion + Higgins injury, Thornton ankle carted + Rice hamstring doubtful (KC), Jeanty ankle, Surtain ankle, Mariota knee + Jaylin Lane season-ending ankle (WSH third-string QB), Edgerrin Cooper Achilles season-ending, Juszczyk knee sprain, Evans fractured ribs played, Donovan Jackson knee, Derwin James out, Price IR + Mixon visit, Legette IR, Coker out, Mayfield thumb 3-6 wks, Harmon/Dean multi-week, Caleb Williams hamstring. Roster: OBJ cut, Porter Jr. DAL debut, LaPorta talks off, Schefter deadline list (MHJ, Sweat, Jeudy, Pollard, Mack). SNF DET-CAR in progress and KC-LV final not confirmed at pull time. Dropped: MLB NLDS (Brewers-Padres), NHL (Florida Panthers Barkov/Marchand, Red Wings-Jets), NBA Brunson, Premier League, Petit Le Mans, college Saturday (Nebraska, A&M camo, Texas Tech-Colorado playbook, USC/Riley, BYU-TCU, Baylor-ASU, NDSU, Vols/Bishop, Houston Cougars, UTSA-Rice, SDSU, LSU/Webbie, Miami Hurricanes injuries, McAfee GameDay), CFL BC Lions, Kelce Redskins slip, Tomlin NBC voice, Russell Wilson hat, Corenswet movie, Thibodeaux outfit, Steve Will Do It bets, Fanatics promo, Circa survivor, Manziel nostalgia, St. Brown-Goff podcast, Bears 'Green Bay Sucks' chant, Philly hell-week multi-sport, Kaliakmanis spin meme, Jeremiah Smith draft dreams, London-team takes, Eden Prairie HS shooting, cross-club duplicates. Quiet/thin: ATL, NO (only MNF hate-week item), MIA (1), HOU (college bleed).
